author: Electronic Arts
description:
To celebrate the launch of the Road Rash: 30th Anniversary Edition, we've put together a new dev diary taking you behind the scenes of the game's restoration process and reflecting on the legacy of the franchise.

Learn how the team digitized higher resolution cinematics from the original Betacam tapes, developed quality-of-life improvements, and brought the classic experience to modern platforms.

Read the article: ea.com/news/from-the-vault-to-your-library
title: EA Classics Restoration Diaries: Reviving the Pure Chaos of Road Rash (30th Anniversary)

author: Electronic Arts
description:
To celebrate the launch of six Wing Commander Anniverary Editions, we've put together a dev diary taking you behind the scenes of the restoration process and reflecting on the legacy of the franchise.

Hear the journey of digitizing the Master FMV tapes, personal stories from original Wing Commander team members, and how a collaboration between EA and the dedicated community led to the restoration of these classic titles.

Read the article: ea.com/news/from-the-vault-to-your-library
title: EA Classics Restoration Diaries: Celebrating the Legacy of Wing Commander
